operation.summary: Change how often one action of an installed applet runs (every_s within the action's min_s..max_s), on every phone; the running watches change in place and keep their counts. dry_run returns the new projection without saving

body.name: every_s
body.description: Seconds between runs, within min_s..max_s (GET …/budget lists the actions)

operation.returns: the backend's projection (dry_run) or the applet's budget after the change

every_s.description: Seconds between runs, within min_s..max_s (GET …/budget lists the actions)

idempotency_key.description: Any UUID; repeating the call with the same key within 24 h returns the first result instead of acting twice
